agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in boltons/urlutils.py: _make_quote_map() had its if/else branches inverted, causing safe characters to be percent-encoded and unsafe characters to be left raw (the opposite of correct behavior). This caused URLs like '.../e-shops.aspx' to be fully percent-encoded on round-trip instead of preserved, breaking roundtrip, query params, and IRI query tests. Swapped the branches so characters in safe_chars remain literal and all others are percent-encoded. Verified via manual URL() construction tests for path, query, and space/special-character handling, confirming correct round-trip behavior is restored.
